title: Glowing bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00e5ff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00e5ff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tubGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b0d8e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='waterGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4dd0e1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0288d1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='45' ry='35' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- tub body -->
  <path d='M15 48 Q13 78 28 84 L72 84 Q87 78 85 48 Z' fill='url(#tubGrad)' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- tub rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='37' ry='10' fill='#f0faff' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- water surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='32' ry='8' fill='url(#waterGrad)'/>

  <!-- water highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='8' ry='2.5' fill='#80deea' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='51' rx='5' ry='1.5' fill='#80deea' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='5' fill='#e0f7fa' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='43' r='4' fill='#e0f7fa' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='41' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='41' r='3' fill='#e0f7fa' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#e0f7fa' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- faucet -->
  <rect x='44' y='28' width='12' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='4' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='29' r='4' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <rect x='49' y='25' width='2' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- water drip from faucet -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='1.8' ry='3' fill='#4dd0e1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='1' ry='1.5' fill='#b2ebf2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- tub feet -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#b0d8e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='86' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#b0d8e8'/>

  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='1' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.35'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='72' r='1' fill='#00e5ff' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
